payload.evidence_against: E013 showed that a 20-well public-mechanism screen can overstate transfer, and prior pseudo-cut coefficient experiments failed because mask-local targets differed from the original boundary. Public notebook lineages also rely heavily on opaque artifacts and public-overlap logic that cannot be reused.
payload.evidence_for: The full likelihood-PF improves E011 from 12.5508 to 11.2011 and the fixed 50/50 blend reaches 9.9839, while stable and heavy-tail HMM branches show complementary behavior on ordinary and observable-edge panels. High-scoring public notebooks repeatedly use visible-prefix self-verification, candidate disagreement, and exact fallback to control branch failures.
payload.next_test: Run the frozen 100-well T041 source audit with three independent trackers, two fixed pseudo-cut profiles, an inverse-MSE primary arbitration rule, exact E011 fallback, and destructive score-routing controls. Escalate only on every registered gate.
payload.statement: Visible-prefix self-verification can identify which public-core trajectory tracker is reliable for each well strongly enough to improve the 50/50 E011–PF baseline and preserve a sub-6 component oracle.
payload.title: Public-core tracker arbitration transfers robustly
